newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Oil adjusts topper capacity.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Oil adjusts topper capacity.

text.p: Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd said on Thursday it had cut the processing capacity of the 150,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) topper at its Mizushima plant, while raising the capacity of a topper owned by an affiliate.

The processing capacity of the 150,000 bpd topper in Mizushima, Okayama Prefecture, southern Japan, was lowered to 130,000 bpd while capacity at Tohoku Oil Co Ltd's 100,000 bpd topper in Sendai, northern Japan, was expanded by 20,000 bpd to 120,000 bpd, a Mitsubishi Oil spokesman said.
The spokesman said the capacity was transferred because of greater refining capacity needs at the Sendai refinery due to the start-up of new secondary refining facilities there.
The Mizushima plant also has a 100,000 bpd crude distillation unit (CDU).

Under government regulations, Japanese oil companies are allowed to increase their overall crude distillation capacity only if the operation rate of the expanded or added CDU is certain to surpass an annual average 80 percent.
